read_inputs: direct pinned WEB Colossians USFM text and coordinates
neutral WEB reader and exact-coordinate coverage logic

decision_policy.primary_rule: Prefer the largest unit completing one prayer, poetic/confessional movement, report, argument, catalogue frame, household address, mission notice, or epistolary close without absorbing the next.

macro_parents.function: Prescript, thanksgiving and report, knowledge/endurance prayer, and deliverance/kingdom transition.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Thanksgiving grounds and prayer petitions remain the opening movement; 1.12-14 may also bridge to 1.15-20.

macro_parents.function: Image/creation/reconciliation poetic or confessional movement and audience application.
macro_parents.seam_hold: The 1.20/1.21 seam turns from universal predicates to direct application without detaching the application.

macro_parents.function: Ministry/stewardship report, struggle, mystery assurance, anti-delusion purpose, and absent/present rejoicing.
macro_parents.seam_hold: The chapter boundary lies inside one ministry-and-struggle movement.

macro_parents.function: Rooted walk, fullness/circumcision/burial/life/triumph argument, judgment/prize warnings, and regulation critique.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Warnings, metaphors, grounds, questions, and evaluation remain one argument parent.

macro_parents.function: Raised-life inference, old/new and vice catalogues, put-on catalogue, peace/word, and thanksgiving frame.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Identity grounds, lists, and all-doing conclusion remain bound together.

macro_parents.function: Complete reciprocal household address across the chapter seam.
macro_parents.seam_hold: All paired addresses, rationales, and the masters counterpart remain together through 4.1.

macro_parents.function: Prayer/watchfulness, outside speech, messenger mission, greetings, letter exchange, charge, autograph, and grace close.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Mission notices and name lists remain inside the epistolary close and authorize no history.

units.literary_rationale: Sender, addressee, and greeting form a compact prescript before plural thanksgiving.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Separating sender and greeting obscures the prescript.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No authorship, audience, apostolic authority, or addressee reading is selected.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Thanksgiving, faith-love-hope report, growth, and Epaphras notice
units.literary_rationale: The thanksgiving grounds expand from faith and love through hope, worldwide growth, Epaphras, and his report.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Detaching the report chain removes the stated thanksgiving grounds.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No gospel-growth, coworker, audience, or mission history is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Knowledge, worthy-walk, endurance prayer, thanksgiving, and deliverance transition
units.literary_rationale: The knowledge petition unfolds into walk, fruit, endurance, and thanksgiving outcomes, then deliverance and redemption clauses complete the prayer horizon.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Splitting participles or deliverance clauses truncates the prayer outcome.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Col.1.15 begins a new he-is anaphoric movement while 1.12-14 remains a held bridge.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No knowledge, inheritance, kingdom, redemption, or salvation doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.literary_rationale: The parallel image, creation, head, fullness, and reconciliation predicates culminate in direct former-now application and continuance clause.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Extracting poetic predicates or application creates source fragments and proof texts.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No hymn source, Christology, cosmology, reconciliation, perseverance, or creation doctrine is selected.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Ministry, stewardship, labor, struggle, mystery assurance, and anti-delusion purpose
units.literary_rationale: The ministry report moves through stewardship, proclamation and labor into struggle for assurance, anti-delusion purpose, and absent/present rejoicing.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: A chapter split severs labor from its stated struggle and purpose.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Col.2.6 begins an as-received therefore walk command.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No suffering, office, mystery, perfection, opponent, or event-history ruling is made.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Rooted walk, anti-capture warning, fullness, circumcision/burial/life, and triumph
units.literary_rationale: The walk exhortation leads to a capture warning whose grounds unfold through fullness, identity metaphors, life, cancellation, and triumph.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Splitting the metaphor chain from warning or inference turns clauses into doctrinal fragments.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Col.2.16 begins a therefore judgment prohibition.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No philosophy, fullness, deity, circumcision, baptism, forgiveness, cosmology, or triumph doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Judgment and prize warnings, body/head contrast, regulation question, and evaluation
units.literary_rationale: Two warnings identify cases and grounds, followed by an if-you-died question, sample regulations, and a final appearance-versus-value judgment.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Atomizing festivals, angels, regulations, or evaluation removes the argument frame.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No Sabbath, food, angel, ascetic, opponent, or practice ruling is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.literary_rationale: The raised condition yields paired above-directed imperatives, a death/hidden-life ground, and a when/then revelation horizon.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Detaching the horizon or grounds weakens the inference.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Col.3.5 begins put-to-death therefore and a vice catalogue.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No raised-life, heaven, hiddenness, or glory doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Put-to-death and put-away catalogues with old-new unity frame
units.literary_rationale: The two catalogues are framed by former-now walk, old/new clothing, renewal, and a status contrast; none is complete alone.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Atomizing vice or status terms removes their old-new frame.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Col.3.12 begins a matching put-on therefore catalogue.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No wrath, vice, identity, ethnicity, slavery, gender/status, or ethics doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Put-on catalogue, love, peace, word, song, all-doing, and thanksgiving
units.literary_rationale: The put-on list expands through relational application, love, peace and word imperatives, song, and the all-doing thanksgiving conclusion.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Separating virtues, peace, word, song, or all-doing conclusion creates context-free commands.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Col.3.18 begins the first household pair.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No virtue, forgiveness, worship, gratitude, or ethics doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.literary_rationale: Three reciprocal pairings culminate across the chapter seam in the masters counterpart; servant rationales remain inside the full frame.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Splitting counterparts or at the chapter seam turns rhetoric into isolated policy.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Col.4.2 begins a prayer imperative outside the household frame.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No household, gender, parenting, slavery, labor, reward, punishment, or institutional authority is selected.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Steadfast prayer, mission request, outsider walk, and gracious speech
units.literary_rationale: Steadfast prayer and mission petition are followed by outsider-facing walk and speech commands linked by how-one-ought language.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Detaching speech or mission rationale turns commands into slogans.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Col.4.7 begins a named messenger notice.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No prayer, mission, imprisonment, outsider ethics, or speech policy is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.literary_rationale: The two messengers, credentials, sending purposes, comfort, and reporting outcome constitute one mission notice.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Separating a messenger from the joint reporting purpose fragments the notice.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No messenger office, identity, itinerary, event sequence, or historical reconstruction is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Coworker greetings and Epaphras prayer report
units.literary_rationale: The greeting names are integrated by relational descriptions, a reception instruction, comfort summary, and Epaphras prayer testimony.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Atomizing names turns a greeting catalogue into unsupported biographies.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Col.4.15 turns to outgoing greetings and letter instructions.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No coworker office, ethnicity, geography, prayer history, or biography is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Outgoing greetings, letter exchange, Archippus charge, autograph, chains, and grace
units.literary_rationale: Outgoing greetings lead to reading/exchange instructions, a relayed charge, and the autograph, chains reminder, and grace close.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Detaching exchange, charge, or autograph fragments the epistolary close.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: No following received Colossians coordinate exists.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No lost-letter, church, office, chains, canon, authorship, or history ruling is made.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

global_premortems.detection: Report grounds or petitions are detached.
global_premortems.mitigation: Retain Col.1.3-14 as the opening parent.

global_premortems.detection: Col.1.15-20 is isolated to assert a hymn source or Christology.
global_premortems.mitigation: Retain movement plus 1.21-23 application and exact alternatives.

global_premortems.detection: Col.1.29/2.1 is treated as a boundary.
Circumcision, burial, life, or triumph clauses are atomized.
global_premortems.mitigation: Retain Col.2.6-15 inside the warning argument.

global_premortems.detection: Festival, angel, or regulation examples become standalone rules.
global_premortems.mitigation: Retain cases, questions, and evaluation in Col.2.16-23.

global_premortems.detection: Col.3.1-4 is detached from therefore catalogues.
global_premortems.mitigation: Preserve the 3.1-17 parent and local exact routes.

global_premortems.detection: Catalogue items lose old/new, love, peace, word, or thanksgiving frames.
global_premortems.mitigation: Retain Col.3.5-17 in two framed units.

global_premortems.detection: Reciprocal pairs become gender, status, slavery, or labor policy.
Messenger and greeting names generate reconstructed history.
global_premortems.mitigation: Keep names inside mission and closing functions.

global_premortems.detection: Col.4.16 is used to settle a lost letter or canon.
global_premortems.mitigation: Retain the instruction in the epistolary close and defer history.

global_premortems.detection: A seam selects witness, reading, punctuation, hymn source, speaker, opponent, or cosmology.
global_premortems.mitigation: Keep every unit LOW/deferred and preserve alternatives.

source_and_authority_guards.direct_source: Pinned WEB Colossians USFM coordinates Col.1.1-Col.4.18

requested_next_review: Blind Greek textual/translation/hymn-source specialist and blind canonical-context/premortem specialist, then peer crosscheck without forced consensus.
